test_escher_runs: test the ESCHER agent runs on kuhn_poker and leduc_poker games
create_escher_config: create an escher.Config with custom value, regret, and avg_policy network hyperparameters
create_escher_agent: create an escher.Agent initialized with an openspiel game and a Config instance
create_train_config: create an escher.TrainConfig with iteration count, nashconv, and games_vs_random settings
run_escher_train: run escher.train with a TrainConfig and Agent to train the ESCHER algorithm
